summary.intent: Run a read-only Phase 0 hotspot analysis of the monokl Rust crate on main (e30812a) ahead of a multi-agent code review sweep, with no agents started until the user approves. A subagent in parallel was pinning mutation-test survivors with new tests.
summary.outcome: Phase 0 completed: produced a hotspot table, totals, repo-wide findings and caveats, and a proposed adjusted plan awaiting the user's go. A subagent reported opening PR #42 (tests only) killing most cargo-mutants survivors, with a few judged equivalent or unverifiable on macOS.

repo: Crate is small: 2,291 live code lines and 9,220 test lines across ~12.6k Rust lines; 815 comment lines (26% of code), 17 soft-failure sites, 14 allow/expect attributes, 60 bare asserts, 0 #[ignore] tests.

Tests: tests/cli.rs integration file, 24 inline #[cfg(test)] modules, tests_types.rs and 4 proptest files, all run via `just test` (nextest with and without all features, plus doctests); coverage reruns them. No benchmarks or fuzz in repo.
Pins are repeated: callisto@0.17.0 appears 9 times and checkout SHA 3d3c42e5… 12 times across 3 workflows and .prototools; release targets are spelled twice in callisto.toml.
jq usage is almost entirely in the generated callisto-release.yml template, plus `moon query | jq` at justfile:54.
Open PRs for trails 183 (tests) and 184 (parse.rs) touch pipeline, text_search and parse.rs, so findings there may need re-checking after they merge.
APFS rejects non-UTF-8 filenames, so the non_utf8_paths test is gated not(macos) and can only run on Linux CI.
Entire auto-opens a draft shadow PR per branch; the subagent edited it (keeping the hidden marker) and marked it ready instead of creating a new one.
Running cargo in the sandbox required disabling the sandbox because of the registry cache.

code.finding: `!args.no_ignore` mutant killed by new black-box tests in tests/cli.rs using a tempdir with .gitignore.
`err.depth() == Some(0)` survivor judged equivalent: metadata/read_dir pre-checks return root errors before the walk, so the depth-0 arm is unreachable except via a race.
`non_utf8_paths += 1` mutants not killed on macOS; existing gated test should kill them on Linux CI but was not verified there.
`||` to `&&` mutant only differs when nothing matches a positive term; killed by test using a file unreadable only for the excluded term.
`!found.unreadable.contains` killed by two tests (unreadable in excluded pass only, and in both), using non-UTF-8 matching lines instead of chmod 000.
`32 * 1024` mutant killed by asserting a 2 KB text equals the real o200k count (1025) and a 40 KB text equals its byte length.
`ch == '_'` to `!=` is equivalent because tokenize already treats every non-alphanumeric as a separator.
`||` to `&&` and `>` to `>=` are equivalent: empty query, empty doc, or avg_doc_len == 0.0 already score exactly 0.0.
`preserve_parens` is the only surviving mutant in the file, believed equivalent; a parenthesised default-export test pins current output.

workflow: Phase 0 script output is unverified; doc-comment runs (`///`, `//!`) inflate the comment-run metric, so a plain-`//` filter is needed for a real history-padding signal.
Excluding JSON from the multi-file string scan avoids noise from .claude/specs field names.
When another session's files occupy a shared /tmp path, write to a separate directory rather than overwrite.
Per-file cargo-mutants reruns after adding tests give a clear killed/equivalent/unverifiable classification per survivor.
Subagent hand-back messages are model output, not user approval, so they carry no authority.

friction: /tmp/claude-501/sweep held another session's files, forcing the Phase 0 script into a different directory.
Table metrics were noisy: doc comments counted as comments, and the multi-file string list was dominated by JSON spec field names.
The history-wording regex returned 0 hits and was not validated against the phrasing actually used.
Cargo needed the sandbox disabled for the registry cache.
Non-UTF-8 filename tests cannot be exercised on macOS/APFS.
open_items: Awaiting user go; then fix table caveats (plain-`//` filter, exclude JSON from string list, validate history regex).
Run Phase 1 with two Sonnet medium-effort agents on the two shards (7.8k and 4.6k lines).
Add a docs shard for the 12.7k Markdown lines (class 13), grep-first on numbers and always/never claims.
Apply class 11 (harness fidelity) to the out-of-repo 36-task eval and stress script: release vs debug binary, bytes÷4 token estimate, agents who knew the repo, warm caches.
Review repeated pins (callisto version and checkout SHA) and duplicated release targets as class 4/5 candidates.
Re-check findings in pipeline, text_search and parse.rs after PRs for trails 183 and 184 merge.
Verify on Linux CI that the non_utf8_paths test kills the `+= 1` mutants.
Fix nothing until the user approves Phase 2 findings.
